Fogarty Finger (FF) is an interdisciplinary design studio of over 145 architects and designers dedicated to placemaking within the urban built environment. Founded in 2003, FF is responsible for many prominent residential and commercial projects throughout the United States with offices in New York, Atlanta, and Boston. 
We believe beautiful spaces build great experiences. Our projects are equally evocative and pragmatic - designed to be enjoyed by everyone. We design for the long term and create thoughtful buildings and interiors with timeless appeal. 
About the Role 
FF is seeking a talented Senior Designer to join our Commercial Interiors studio in New York office. You will be leading design development, consultant coordination and project management across all phases – from schematic design through construction administration. The right candidate brings a balance of technical rigor and design sensibility, paired with strong organizational skills, clear communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This is a role with real responsibilities and a clear path toward a leadership role over time.
What You’ll Do 
- Lead design reviews across all project phases to develop and advance design intent that reflects FF’s design brand 
  
- Select materials and finishes to ensure alignment with design intent
  
- Develop technical solutions and construction details in close collaboration with the design team
  
- In charge of producing drawing sets and 3D models in Revit in accordance with FF’s documentation and BIM standards
  
- Ensure compliance with applicable local building      codes, ADA requirement, and other regulatory standards throughout all      documentation phases
  
- Effectively      manage consultants’ drawings, deliverables, and schedules during DD, CD,      and CA phases
 
- Optimize and improve the efficiency and accuracy      of Revit models.
  
- Manage      CA responsibilities, including field coordination with trades and      consultants, shop drawing review, and construction sketches
  
- Maintain      and ensure QA/QC in accordance with FF’s standards
 
- Manage multiple tasks and schedules across concurrent projects with competing deadlines
  
- Identify potential issues early and find resolutions in a timely manner
  
- Effectively mentor junior staff in the team 
What You Bring 
- A professional degree in Architecture from an accredited institution
  
- 6-10 years of relevant professional experience at a similar architecture or interior design firm
  
- Demonstrated experience producing quality CD packages and DOB permit sets
  
- Working knowledge of NYC building codes, Landmarks requirements, ADA requirements, and other applicable standards
  
- Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with the ability to present confidently in both internal and client-facing settings
  
- Proficiency in Revit required; working knowledge of AutoCAD
  
- Active pursuit of architectural licensure (ARE) or NCIDQ certification is preferred
  
- Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. 
  
- Experience across      a range of project types, including high-end commercial,      amenity/hospitality, and workplace interiors
  
- Ability to lead design      concepts into buildable, real-world solutions
 
- Strong      knowledge of architectural detailing, including experience drafting custom      design elements
  
- Competence      in sourcing materials and writing specifications
 
- Strong ability to      communicate and coordinate effectively with consultants, clients, and      contractors
  
- Experience completing      multiple projects from initial concept through CA
 
- Hardworking,      detail-oriented, and independently motivated, with strong problem-solving      skills
Why Join FF? 
Fogarty Finger has never stopped growing — and neither will you. Since our founding, we've expanded steadily across New York, Atlanta, and Boston, taking on a remarkable breadth of project types along the way. As a mid-sized firm, we blend the best aspects of large and small firm culture. Joining our New York office means genuine exposure to the full arc of design, from early concept through construction administration, across residential, commercial, workplace, and hospitality work. You won't be pigeon-holed into a single phase or project type — you'll be in the room for all of it.
Please visit our website www.fogartyfinger.com for more information.
